brand.name: Rosemary Epass
approvedOverrides: Retain green product primary with 24 complete light/dark roles.
Product owner requested capital initials: Rosemary Epass.
Product owner requested rounded arch feet and tonal layers on the Epass product badge. Mother-brand bitmap is unchanged.

motion.overlay: Official overlay retained until actual animation completion; interruption reverses from current frame; native focus restoration.
motion.preferences: System reduced motion takes priority; persisted user reduction also applies; official loading stops on document/lifecycle background.

passwordPolicy.rules: 8–128 printable ASCII characters; at least two of letters, digits and symbols; spaces do not count as symbols; no edge spaces; reject known common/decorated/repeated patterns
passwordPolicy.advice: Long unique passphrases; avoid account information; use a password manager. Cross-site or historical password reuse is not assessed by the client.
passwordPolicy.feedback: Immediate local checks with linked field descriptions and polite status; invalid passwords disable submission in registration, recovery and admin creation.
passwordPolicy.compatibility: New-password policy only. Existing weak and non-ASCII hashes still verify.
passwordPolicy.referenceNote: Google guidance informs advice; the 8-character minimum and two-category requirement are product requirements.

flutterSdk.inputAdapter: Official controlled inputs; native editor adapter where 0.4.0 lacks autofill/IME support.
